ai.md: 1. Diagrammtyp & Architektur-Kontext UML-Klassendiagramm / Schnittstellendefinition zur AUTOSAR Classic Platform (DCM - Diagnostic Communication Manager). Dargestellt ist das Interface DCMServices mit der Serviceschnittstelle Dcm_Services sowie den zugehörigen Typdefinitionen ( «typedef» ) aus dem Paket Dcm_Types . 2. Komponenten, Entitäten & Schnittstellen UML-Rahmen class DCMServices mit folgenden Entitäten: - «interface» Dcm_Services : - Dcm_GetSecurityLevel(return :Std_ReturnType, SecLevel :Dcm_SecLevelType ) - Dcm_GetSesCtrlType(return :Std_ReturnType, SesCtrlType :Dcm_SesCtrlType ) - Dcm_GetActiveProtocol(return :Std_ReturnType, ActiveProtocol :Dcm_ProtocolType ) - «typedef» Dcm_Types::Dcm_SecLevelType (Basistyp uint8 ): - DCM_SEC_LEV_LOCKED = 0x00 - DCM_SEC_LEV_L1 = 0x01 - configuration dependent: uint8 = 0x02...0x7F - Reserved by Document: uint8 = 0x80...0xFE - DCM_SEC_LEV_ALL: uint8 = 0xFF - «typedef» Dcm_Types::Dcm_SesCtrlType (Basistyp uint8 ): - DEFAULT_SESSION = 0x01 - PROGRAMMING_SESSION = 0x02 - EXTENDED_DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION = 0x03 - SAFETY_SYSTEM_DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION = 0x04 - configuration dependent = 0x05...0x7F - Reserved by Document = 0x80...0xFE - ALL_SESSION_LEVEL = 0xFF - «typedef» Dcm_Types::Dcm_ProtocolType (Basistyp uint8 ): - DCM_OBD_ON_CAN = 0x00 - DCM_UDS_ON_CAN = 0x01 - DCM_UDS_ON_FLEXRAY = 0x02 - DCM_ROE_ON_CAN = 0x03 - DCM_ROE_ON_FLEXRAY = 0x04 - DCM_PERIODICTRANS_ON_CAN = 0x05 - DCM_PERIODICTRANS_ON_FLEXRAY = 0x06 - Reserved for further AUTOSAR imp
